To make deep or deeper

examples.text: They deepened the well by 200 feet.

glosses: To make darker or more intense; to darken

examples.text: The event deepened the prevailing gloom.

glosses: To make more poignant or affecting; to increase in degree

examples.text: News of her death deepened my sorrow.

glosses: To make lower in tone

examples.text: The tuner deepened the tone of the organ.

glosses: To make more thorough or extensive.

examples.text: The class deepened my understanding of the subject.

glosses: To make more intimate.

examples.text: The shared experiences deepened our relationship.

glosses: To make more sound or heavy.

examples.text: The hypnotist then proceeded to deepen his trance.

glosses: To become deeper

examples.text: The water deepens as you go toward the middle of the channel.

glosses: To become darker or more intense

examples.text: The crisis deepened in the following weeks.

We may be pardoned our nostalgia, those of us who can remember the old days, the days before the grouping and before standardisation, when we see, as today we see so often, the derelict and abandoned buildings of what were once railway stations, for the life which they used to enjoy we lived with them. There they stand, today, as the dusk deepens about them, lampless, cold and deserted.

glosses: To become lower in tone

examples.text: His voice deepened with age.

glosses: To become more thorough or extensive.

examples.text: His skill in deciphering the texts deepened with practice.

glosses: To become more intimate.

examples.text: The conversation deepened and they began to truly share.
He's in the process of breaking up with one boyfriend, who refuses to let their relationship deepen, and courting another, who promises to be somebody with whom he could grow old.

glosses: To become more sound or heavy.

examples.text: The new bed allowed my sleep to deepen.

examples.text: Die Gräben links und rechts des Weges werden dieses Jahr vertieft.

examples.text: Ich habe mir vorgenommen, meine Kenntnisse über neuronale Vorgänge zu vertiefen.
Die gegenseitige Zuneigung vertiefte sich im Laufe der Zeit.

examples.text: „Den Halsausschnitt an der Schulter um 2,5 cm erweitern, an VM und HM um 2,5 cm vertiefen.“

glosses: sich vollständig auf etwas konzentrieren

examples.text: Wenn Kilian sich in sein Hobby vertieft, vergisst er reglmäßig, zu Abend zu essen.

examples.text: The desert extended for miles in all directions.

glosses: To cause to increase in extent.
To cause to last for a longer period of time.
To straighten (a limb).
To bestow; to offer; to impart; to apply.

examples.text: to extend sympathy to the suffering
to extend credit to a valued customer

glosses: To increase in quantity by weakening or adulterating additions.

examples.text: There's little stew left, but we can always extend it by adding more potatoes.

Of a class: to be an extension or subtype of, or to be based on, a prototype or a more abstract class.

examples.text: The classes Person and Dog extend the class Animal.

examples.text: Two years later, back to amtracs, this time at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, and I liked it so much I extended.

glosses: To become intense, or more intense; to act with increasing power or energy.

examples.text: Feminist critiques of continuity discourse have become increasingly audible within the mainstream Jewish world, intensifying last year after [Steven M.] Cohen himself was accused of serial sexual harassment.
